STATEMENT OF ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
July 9, 2026



This Statement of Additional Information (the “SAI”) is not a prospectus and should be read in conjunction with the prospectus for the Overlay Shares Enhanced Equity Fund (the “Enhanced Equity Fund”) and the Overlay Shares Hedged Equity Fund (the “Hedged Equity Fund”) (each, a “Fund,” and together, the “Funds”), each a series of Listed Funds Trust (the “Trust”), dated July 9, 2026, as may be supplemented from time to time (the “Prospectus”). Capitalized terms used in this SAI that are not defined have the same meaning as in the Prospectus, unless otherwise noted. A copy of the Prospectus may be obtained, without charge, by calling the Funds at 855-522-8565, or by visiting lsfunds.com.
The Funds’ audited financial statements for the most recent fiscal year (when available) will be included in the Funds’ most recent Form N-CSR filing, which will be incorporated into this SAI by reference (File No. 811-23226). When available, you may obtain a copy of the Funds’ Annual Report and Form N-CSR at no charge by contacting the Funds at the phone number noted above.
